snippet.title: American Arcadia 📹  | Coming to Consoles May 15th
snippet.description:
American Arcadia, developed by Out Of The Blue and published by Raw Fury, is coming to consoles on May 15th. 

After garnering a lot of positive reviews following its release on Steam, this puzzle and platforming adventure that mixes 2D and 3D in its gameplay arrives to PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series S | X and Nintendo Switch. 

With its intricate narrative and witty humour, it will transport us to the 70s and let us visit the retro-futuristic city of Arcadia once more.

Add it to your wishlist now!
Xbox: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9pklv32pstgm
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10006434
